assets.label: Fig4
assets.caption: Figure 4: Training Framework of SODiff. First, the Prompt Track uses the first-stage trained SAIPE to extract semantic-oriented embeddedimageguidanceeimgfromIL.Second,theTimestepTrackperformsOSDtimestepandQFprediction,obtaining τpredand computing Lqf. Next, ILis encoded into latent space through the frozen VAE encoder to obtain zL, with eimgand τpredproviding conditional control for the noise prediction UNet, which performs one-step noise prediction to obtainˆzH. The SDXL Discriminator receives the transformed eimg, ˆzH, and the latent space representation zHof IHto compute LG. Last, ˆzH passes through the frozen VAE Decoder to obtain the reconstructed imageˆIH, which computes Lreconwith IH.
